sources.name: Smart Nicosia platform
sources.publisher: Municipality of Nicosia, on Nokia's city platform
sources.gives: Street lights, parking bays, bins, air and noise sensors, info screens, traffic cameras and their counts, the city's speed and alarms
sources.refresh: Every 5 minutes while a page is open

sources.name: Live bus positions (GTFS-RT)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Works, through the Cyprus National Access Point
sources.gives: Where each bus is now, and how late it runs
sources.refresh: Every 30 seconds at most while a page is open
sources.credit: Buses: Ministry of Transport, CC BY 4.0

sources.name: Bus timetables (GTFS)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Works, through the Cyprus National Access Point
sources.gives: Lines, stops, timetables and route shapes of NPT, Intercity and Pame Express

sources.name: Road speeds (Bluetooth travel times)
sources.gives: Speeds on the main avenues, timed between Bluetooth detectors

sources.name: Open-Meteo
sources.gives: The weather now and by the hour, sunrise and sunset, modelled air quality and dust, and the weather at past moments of the city clock

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.gives: Streets, places and their opening hours, and the data under the base map
sources.refresh: The places index is rebuilt weekly

sources.name: OpenFreeMap
sources.gives: The base map's tiles, by day and by night
sources.refresh: Tiles as you move the map

sources.name: Valhalla routing
sources.publisher: The Valhalla project, on FOSSGIS's public server
sources.gives: Walking and driving routes, how far you reach on foot, walks to and from the bus, the streets traffic counts run along, and free-flow speeds for the roads
sources.refresh: Asked per route, kept when it can be

sources.name: Address search
sources.gives: Turning names and addresses into places, and places into addresses

sources.name: Web search
sources.publisher: The web pages Claude's web search finds
sources.gives: Places the map doesn't list, such as teachers, studios, shops and services, with their addresses, phones and websites, and events and news
sources.refresh: Asked per question; places found are kept with the page they came from

sources.name: Department of Lands and Surveys (DLS)
sources.gives: Every building in 3D at its height and floors, and the plots they stand on
sources.refresh: Fetched once per area, then kept

sources.name: Dangerous-building registers
sources.publisher: District local government organisations (ΕΟΑ) of Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca and Famagusta
sources.gives: Buildings declared dangerous or in need of repair
sources.refresh: Read again once a day, with a saved copy when a register can't be read

status.note: some districts show a saved copy

parts.name: Nicosia
parts.note: a saved copy: the live register couldn't be read

parts.name: Larnaca
parts.note: a saved copy: the live register couldn't be read

sources.name: The twin's memory
sources.gives: History, the usual for each hour, and the city clock: what the sources above reported, kept as it arrived
sources.refresh: Records while a page is open; older history is filled in by the collector
